grammar: c
asserts: values, tql_tree, source_tree, bytecode

--- tql ---
. / function_definition as @func | {
  fn: @func,
  int_params: [
    @func.declarator.parameters / parameter_declaration as @p |
    @p.type as @t |
    select(@t | text = 'int') |
    @p
  ]
}

int main(void) { return 0; }
